name: Start TOTP Enrollment
description: Introduces authenticator enrollment and lets an authenticated user explicitly begin the server-backed enrollment operation.

web.notes: Start explicitly invokes BeginTotpEnrollment and stages the returned secret and otpauth URI in ephemeral client flow state before navigating to auth.mfa.totp.enroll.

mobile.notes: Canonical surface added before the existing QR/secret enrollment view so BeginTotpEnrollment executes only after an explicit user action.

notes: This view intentionally does not display the QR code or authenticator secret. Those values belong exclusively to auth.mfa.totp.enroll after the begin-enrollment server operation succeeds.
